        <script>
        const page = `<p>
            one   

            two
        </p>`;
        const q = sql`select *
          from t`;
        const n = `outer ${items
            .map(
                (i) => `<li>
            ${i}
        </li>`,
            )
            .join("")} end`;
        /* a plain
           block comment */
        /**
         * a JSDoc one
         */
        go(page, q, n);
        </script>
    </div>
</div>

          from t`;

			.map(
